Name: Soren Mallow - The Orchard Graftmaster
Author: AleksSmash2020
Description:
Soren Mallow is a quiet orchard experimenter who teaches the player how to create three original fruit-tree hybrids. He is a non-romance NPC with his own schedule, dialogue, gift reactions, friendship events, letters, custom fruit, and custom saplings.

The main feature is a deterministic grafting progression. After meeting Soren, the player can build friendship with him and unlock one new grafting pattern at each major stage. The first lesson arrives at two hearts, the second at five hearts, and the final lesson at eight hearts. Each lesson is delivered through a normal letter that teaches a crafting recipe.

The Suncrisp Graft uses one Apricot, one Hot Pepper, and five Hardwood. It creates a Suncrisp Sapling, which grows into a summer fruit tree and produces Suncrisp Fruit when the tree is in season.

The Moonberry Graft uses one Blueberry, one Crystal Fruit, and five Hardwood. It creates a Moonberry Sapling, which grows into a winter fruit tree and produces Moonberries during winter. This gives the player a long-term orchard option for a season when most outdoor fruit trees are dormant.

The Brambleapple Graft uses one Apple, one Blackberry, and five Hardwood. It creates a Brambleapple Sapling, which grows into a fall fruit tree and produces Brambleapples during fall.

Every graft is a real crafting choice. The player must supply the ingredients, choose which sapling to create, and decide where to plant it. The recipes do not replace vanilla saplings, grant combat power, add a new currency, or create a free infinite reward. The point is to give orchard planning a small story and three distinct seasonal options.

The pack includes Soren Mallow, four deterministic heart events, three custom fruit objects, three custom sapling objects, three custom fruit-tree definitions, three grafting recipes, mail, schedules, gift tastes, English text, Russian text, original character assets, object textures, and fruit-tree textures.

This is a Content Patcher content pack for Stardew Valley 1.6. Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or later and Content Patcher 2.9.0 or later, then place the folder named Soren Mallow - The Orchard Graftmaster inside the Mods folder. Keep the folder structure intact.

The pack does not include a custom DLL, an AI dialogue service, a companion system, a town request board, a market-price simulator, a museum exchange, a beach salvage loop, or a river survey system. It uses namespaced IDs and vanilla data assets to reduce the chance of collisions. Large expansion maps may change how vanilla locations and schedules behave, so compatibility with heavily edited maps depends on those map changes.

Created by AleksSmash2020 with AI assistance for original writing and visual concept development. No third-party portraits, sprites, code, branding, or character designs are bundled. The package is checked statically for JSON structure, references, localization parity, duplicate Load targets, image dimensions, and archive contents. The game and SMAPI were not launched during preparation.
